analysis_steps.goal: Measure optical emission-line ratios of the regions

method.value: Extract spectra at the PSF FWHM diameter, decompose blended lines with Gaussians, correct for extinction, integrate fluxes, form ratios

evidence.quote: The spectra of these regions were extracted from this data cube and the diameter of the extraction area was equal to the FWHM of the PSF of these data
In order to calculate the emission-line ratios, we decomposed those blended lines in Gaussians functions.

evidence.loc: Spectra of the observed regions and emission-line decompositions

claims.hypothesis: Where is the AGN relative to the double stellar nucleus and the nuclear spiral?
claims.experiment: Compared HST F814W images from 2001 and 2018 and overlaid the ALMA CO(3-2) image
claims.result: A variable point source V1 appears between N1 and N2, 0.24 +/- 0.04 arcsec from the [O I] centre, at the centre of the nuclear spiral
claims.finding: The AGN is most likely the central variable source V1

evidence.loc: The double stellar nucleus and the AGN
evidence.quote: So, the main hypothesis here is that AGN is the central variable source (V1) and also the centre of the nuclear spiral.

claims.hypothesis: Is the molecular ring fed by the bar and the nuclear spiral?
claims.experiment: Compared CO(3-2) from ALMA with HST dust-extinction structure
claims.result: Dust-affected areas connect to the molecular ring; the spiral passes between N1 and N2
claims.finding: The ring is fed by the bar and the spiral may bring gas and dust to the centre

evidence.quote: This reinforces the hypothesis of the feeding of the circumnuclear ring by the bar proposed by (cite: boker) and (cite: audibert).

claims.hypothesis: What produces the hard X-ray emission in the circumnuclear ring?
claims.experiment: Chandra hard X-ray imaging compared with Br-gamma, [Fe II] and H2 ring parameters
claims.result: A ring with geometry consistent with the NIR and radio ring is seen in hard X-rays
claims.finding: The ring emission most likely comes from supernova remnants

evidence.quote: Our interpretation is that it is most likely originated from supernova remnants (SNRs) associated with the young stellar population.

claims.hypothesis: Does extended soft X-ray emission trace the ionization cone?
claims.experiment: Compared Chandra 0.5-2 keV image with [O III] contours
claims.result: Good spatial coincidence between soft X-rays and [O III] emission
claims.finding: Highly ionized gas is present in the ionization cone

evidence.quote: this clearly shows that there is highly ionized gas in the ionization cone.

claims.hypothesis: Is the double stellar nucleus two real nuclei?
claims.experiment: Compared HST, GMOS and SINFONI morphologies and dust structure
claims.result: A nuclear spiral and dust stream lie between N1 and N2
claims.finding: Two hypotheses remain: one extended structure divided by dust, or two orbiting structures

evidence.loc: The global scenario for the central region
evidence.quote: There are, therefore, two hypotheses to explain them

referee_caveats_inferred: ALMA-to-SINFONI registration was done by matching the ring by eye, so offsets between CO(3-2), HST and optical frames have no quoted uncertainty
V1 as the AGN rests on a 2001 versus 2018 comparison of different instruments (WFPC2 vs WFPC3) after PSF matching, with no photometric error budget given
Hard X-ray ring attributed to supernova remnants without spectral or source-count evidence
ALMA data play only a qualitative role, with no flux or kinematic measurement

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: ALMA CO(3-2) cube likely a few GB; the full multiwavelength reproduction also needs HST, Chandra, SINFONI, GMOS and SIFS data, tens of GB in total
reproducibility.score_reason: The ALMA step is trivial (collapse a public cube), but the results depend on non-ALMA data and proprietary IDL scripts, and registration and region extraction details are missing.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: ALMA role is a qualitative overlay, the recipe lacks key details, and the main results are mostly positions and morphology from other facilities.
